limitations: The digital-attention chart includes only digital-first businesses; its values do not account for multitasking.
The soundbar chart uses 2016 population data, and its figures may not total 100% because of rounding.
The digital newspapers and magazines figures exclude advertising.
Global ARPU figures use consolidated global revenues with stated exceptions: Apple equipment sales exclude accessories, apps, and iPods; Amazon excludes services; Facebook uses advertising revenue.

U.S. ARPU figures use stated company-specific measures; DirecTV is estimated by growing its 2014 ARPU at the average rate of other listed Pay TV providers, and Netflix includes streaming revenue only.
